questions.stem: The speaker suggests that an effect of the Industrial Revolution is that

options.B: workers were paid well for their labor after years of struggle
options.C: agricultural production suffered as industrial production expanded
options.D: the United States surpassed Great Britain economically by the end of the eighteenth century

questions.stem: What is the significance of the year 1760 to the Industrial Revolution?

options.A: The greatest milestones of the Industrial Revolution occurred in 1760.
options.B: The Industrial Revolution began in Great Britain around 1760.
options.C: The Industrial Revolution reached Continental Europe around 1760.
options.D: The year 1760 marks the beginning of the labor movement in Europe.

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest about the use of James Watt’s steam engine?

options.A: It led to the development of the spinning jenny.
options.B: It had little importance outside of the English cotton manufacturing system.
options.C: It enabled factories to operate in cities far from moving water.
options.D: It added vast numbers of laborers to England’s agricultural workforce.

questions.stem: What was one effect of the invention of the spinning jenny?

options.A: Textiles could be produced with far fewer workers than before.
options.B: The English cotton industry was overtaken by the American cotton industry.
options.C: Many workers left their factory jobs and returned to the countryside.
options.D: It allowed James Watt to open his own factory.
